incident-bot: [pager] ALERT: spike in auth-proxy 401s from ~120 unique IPs, seen in us-west-2 edge pool. Suspected automated probe. Ticket: INC-328999
jamal: seeing same in dashboards — unusual header pattern x-forwarded-user: "svcacct/unknown". digging logs now.
alex: @jamal can you paste earliest sample? I can put a WAF block on those UA strings.
jamal: grep shows repeated entries in /var/log/proxy/access.log.gz -> `tail -n 200 | grep "x-forwarded-user" | head` -> ```203.0.113.45 - - "GET /v1/generate" 401 "x-forwarded-user: svcacct/unknown:tokenfrag"```
maria: wow that looks like a partial token in header. Could be leaked logs elsewhere.
sarah: are those requests hitting hosted API or Dedicated? customer impact?
jamal: mostly hosted public endpoints, small % hitting some Dedicated frontends in us-west-2. early estimate: 0.02% of overall traffic; 401s only, no successful auth observed.
leo: good — still we should assume tokens may be exposed. Recommend immediate rotation of the implicated service account and spool of short-lived creds.
alex: WAF rule in place (blocking UA pattern and the 203.0.113.0/24 range) — rolled at 3289990020. Monitoring.
incident-bot: action logged: WAF rule applied by alex at 3289990020. Pager duty notified.
jamal: started a search for logsink configs referencing /staging/logs -> found a misconfigured forwarder with `s3://redwood-staging-archives/debug/` that had public ACL earlier this week.
maria: timeline: forwarder ACL changed 3 days ago (by ci-bot) — looks like debug logs containing request headers were exposed for ~48h.
leo: OK, rotate any service tokens that appear in those logs. Priority: svc-token-ops1, svc-batcher, ci-deployer. @oncall-ops please start rotation and notify customers if any tokens are customer-managed.
oncall-ops: taking on rotate task now. ETA 15m for primary svc-token-ops1. I'll post status.
alex: also enabling prefix KV cache invalidation for affected frontends (to avoid stale routing with old creds). Pushing in 30s.
sarah: customer impact assessment: no successful auth observed. Risk: leaked header fragments could allow credential reconstruction — treat as moderate. Recommend short customer notice template ready if we find any successful calls.
legal-team: standby for customer comms. If any customer-managed keys found in exposed path, we need to notify within 72h. Collect list of affected customers.
jamal: live grep for full token patterns across archived logs now. If found I'll paste redacted examples.
jamal: found three full token strings in debug bucket (redacted) — placing them into secure ticket INC-328999-keys for rotation and forensic.
oncall-ops: rotated svc-token-ops1 and svc-batcher at 3289990065. Confirmed 401s drop ~90% after rotate + WAF.
alex: good. adding fallback: route to regional replica if auth failures spike again.
leo: postmortem action items: 1) tighten log forwarder ACL policies (infra); 2) scrub debug header logging in prod (eng-runtime); 3) automated scanning to detect tokens in logs (sec); 4) update rotation playbook (ops).
maria: assigning owners in ticket.
incident-bot: incident status => CONTAINED. last update 3289990120. Incident channel lock: no external posting without legal signoff.
jamal: leaving oncall to jamal -> oncall-ops handoff complete. I'm available for forensics.
oncall-ops: monitoring for 2h; will run CVE-style sweep for any replay attempts and update ticket.
legal-team: prepping customer-notice draft; will review with maria before send.
leo: thanks team. quick retro after stabilization. :thumbsup:
